tools.name: find_origami
tools.description: Searches public paper crafts by query, difficulty and category, returning ranked projects, paper requirements, lesson links and pagination.

tools.name: get_origami
tools.description: Returns a model’s difficulty, paper requirements, materials and lesson links for a slug, identifier or unambiguous name.

tools.name: get_origami_steps
tools.description: Returns all illustrated folding instructions and the Finish note for a model slug, identifier or unambiguous name.

tools.name: suggest_origami
tools.description: Filters projects by occasion, age, estimated duration, difficulty and category, returning ranked matches and pagination.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists public craft categories with project counts and page links.
